AMD Joins $1 Trillion Market Cap Club Amid AI Demand Surge

Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) has surpassed a $1 trillion market capitalization for the first time, following a nearly 10% surge in its shares. This milestone caps an 185% increase in AMD's stock value in 2026. CEO Lisa Su has been credited with transforming the company into a significant competitor to NVIDIA, particularly in the fields of AI computing and server processors. The rally in chipmakers' stocks is attributed to surging demand driven by artificial intelligence.
